idea-plugin.name: Json2Typescript
idea-plugin.description:
Json2Typescript is a lightweight IntelliJ / WebStorm plugin that converts JSON into clean TypeScript type definitions — right from the editor, no configuration needed.

Features:

  • One-click conversion: right-click in editor or press Ctrl+Alt+V to convert clipboard or selected JSON.
  • Selection-first: if text is selected it's used directly; otherwise falls back to clipboard — no copy-paste required.
  • Literal union detection: ["pending", "done", "cancelled"] automatically becomes "pending" | "done" | "cancelled".
  • Date string recognition: fields named *Time / *Date with ISO 8601 values are typed as Date.
  • Nested objects & arrays: each nesting level gets its own export type, with duck-typing deduplication.
  • Bean suffix stripping: backend Java bean names like userVO, orderDTO, createRequest are automatically shortened to User, Order, Create.
  • Optional fields auto-marked: fields missing from some array elements become ?:.
  • Null inference by key: userId: null → number, isDeleted: null → boolean, etc.
  • Lenient JSON parsing: single quotes, unquoted keys, comments, trailing commas all accepted — copy from browser / logs without cleanup.
  • TS reserved-word quoting: keys named class, default, interface are auto-quoted.

Just copy JSON and generate types instantly. Works with clipboard or editor selection.

action.description: Convert selected JSON or clipboard JSON into TypeScript type definitions
